description: This file defines a report parser class for generating general journal reports in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including methods for setting context, retrieving lines, and summing debit/credit amounts per period and journal.

classes.name: journal_print
classes.description: A report parser class for generating general journal reports, handling context setup, data retrieval, and calculations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser with context and local variables.

methods.name: set_context
methods.description: Sets the context for report generation, retrieving period and journal IDs based on input data.

methods.name: periods
methods.description: Returns a list of unique period objects from journal period objects.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Retrieves move lines grouped by period and journal, with filtering options.

methods.name: _sum_debit_period
methods.description: Calculates total debit for a given period and journal(s).

methods.name: _sum_credit_period
methods.description: Calculates total credit for a given period and journal(s).

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Calculates total debit across multiple periods and journals.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Calculates total credit across multiple periods and journals.
